data.exact_reserve_text: The 2017 underwriting year has closed with a declared loss of $17.1m, which represents a loss on capacity of 27.9%. The syndicate has incurred material losses as a result of the natural catastrophe events of 2017 and 2018. The impact of the property reinsurance loss on the 2017 year of account closing return on capacity, has been partially offset by the profitability of the cyber business.
